item.title: Former Audacy COO Takes Top RCS Worldwide Role - Radio Ink
item.description: She was a Regional VP at Cox Media Group and most recently served as Chief Operating Officer of Audacy Inc. Now, she's joining iHeartMedia-owned RCS Worldwide to oversee the RCS brand of radio programming software, in addition to the Media Monitors, Mediabase and Florical Systems product lines.

item.title: National Black Radio Hall of Fame Reveals 2026 Class - Radio Ink
item.description: This year’s honorees span multiple categories and hail from 19 different states. There are a host of highly familiar names, including an iconic R&B recording artist who first found fame with Rufus. Introducing the Class of 2026 inductees to the National Black Radio Hall of Fame.

item.title: Broadcast Radio Attribution Comes From Magellan AI - Radio Ink
item.description: The "Broadcast Radio Attribution" offering, says Magellan AI, can allow a marketer to directly evaluate how radio campaigns contribute to key business outcomes—including form fills, leads, and purchases—while comparing performance across podcasts, streaming audio, connected TV, and other media.

item.title: Superadio Amplifies 'Essential Ebro' in Distribution Deal - Radio Ink
item.description: Amplified Voices, powered by Superadio Networks, has teamed up with Dad Life LLC to launch a series curating clipped highlights from “The Ebro Laura Rosenberg Show” in a cross-platform digital distribution deal.

item.title: David Tyler Connects with Hoss Management Group - Radio Ink
item.description: In Canada, he's familiar as the national voice of Bell Media's CTV News, and for his work at Montréal radio stations once branded as "Mix 96" and "Q92." In the U.S., he was the voice of WTVR "Mix 98.1" in Richmond. Now, he's joined Hoss Management Group for radio imaging and voiceover representation.

item.title: A Validation of ZoneCasting Performance Arrives From India - Radio Ink
item.description: Synchronized booster transmitters enabled smooth, uninterrupted transitions between coverage areas, even in dense urban environments and challenging terrain. In fully synchronous mode, transitions between the primary signal and boosters were seamless, with no perceptible impact to audio quality.

item.title: What Were You Like In The '90s? - Radio Ink
item.description: Why is 1990s nostalgia hitting so much harder than past nostalgic trends, particularly for today’s Millennials? Mike McVay has some thoughts about an era when Contemporary Hit Radio hit rock bottom before embracing Britney and Boy Bands, while Alternative music exploded and "Lilith Fair" opened new doors.

item.title: Andy & Kat Step Up The Love For Ronald McDonald House - Radio Ink
item.description: A Sarkes Tarzian-owned radio station serving Fort Wayne, Ind., has successfully raised nearly $40,000 for Ronald McDonald House Charities of Northeast Indiana, thanks to the efforts of "Andy & Kat in the Morning."

item.title: Lock In The Best Hotel Rate For The Hispanic Radio Conference! - Radio Ink
item.description: The lowest hotel rate for Radio Ink’s 2026 Hispanic Radio Conference at the Hilton Phoenix Tapatio Cliffs Resort ends April 4.
